title: चत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 140 · Night: Drona against the Pandavas

summary.en: In the dreadful night battle Virata and Drupada rush at Drona, and Shalya and Kritavarman come against Yudhishthira. Arjuna cuts Drona's bow and strikes his arrows as Kritavarman shields Drona.
summary.kn: ಭಯಂಕರ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿರಾಟ, ದ್ರುಪದರು ದ್ರೋಣನ ಮೇಲೆ ಎರಗುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಶಲ್ಯ, ಕೃತವರ್ಮರು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನ ದ್ರೋಣನ ಬಿಲ್ಲು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕೃತವರ್ಮ ದ್ರೋಣನನ್ನು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भयंकर रात्रियुद्ध में विराट और द्रुपद द्रोण पर टूटते हैं और शल्य तथा कृतवर्मा युधिष्ठिर के सामने आते हैं। अर्जुन द्रोण का धनुष काटते हैं और कृतवर्मा द्रोण की रक्षा करता है।
summary.te: భయంకర రాత్రియుద్ధంలో విరాటుడు, ద్రుపదుడు ద్రోణునిపై దూకుతారు; శల్యుడు, కృతవర్మ యుధిష్ఠిరునిపైకి వస్తారు. అర్జునుడు ద్రోణుని విల్లు ఛేదిస్తాడు; కృతవర్మ ద్రోణుని కాపాడతాడు.
summary.ta: கொடிய இரவுப்போரில் விராடனும் துருபதனும் த்ரோணரைத் தாக்க, சல்யனும் கிருதவர்மனும் யுதிஷ்டிரரை எதிர்க்கின்றனர். அர்ஜுனன் த்ரோணரின் வில்லை வெட்ட, கிருதவர்மன் த்ரோணரைக் காக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ഭയങ്കരമായ രാത്രിയുദ്ധത്തിൽ വിരാടനും ദ്രുപദനും ദ്രോണരുടെ നേർക്ക് പാഞ്ഞടുക്കുന്നു; ശല്യരും കൃതവർമാവും യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെതിരെ വരുന്നു. അർജുനൻ ദ്രോണരുടെ വില്ല് മുറിക്കുന്നു; കൃതവർമാവ് ദ്രോണരെ സംരക്ഷിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.140; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे रात्रियुद्धे विशां पते ।
सर्वभूतक्षयकरे धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: While that dreadful night battle, destroyer of all creatures, went on, O lord of the people, Yudhishthira, son of Dharma,

verses.text:
अब्रवीत्पाण्डवांश्चैव पाञ्चालांश्च ससोमकान् ।
अभ्यद्रवत गच्छध्वं द्रोणमेव जिघांसया ॥

meaning.en: said to the Pandavas and to the Panchalas with the Somakas: "Rush on, go straight at Drona, to kill him."

verses.text:
राज्ञस्ते वचनाद्राजन्पाञ्चालाः सोमकास्तथा ।
द्रोणमेवाभ्यवर्तन्त नदन्तो भैरवान्रवान् ॥

meaning.en: At the king's word, O king, the Panchalas and Somakas turned on Drona alone, uttering fearful roars.

verses.text:
तान्वयं प्रतिगर्जन्तः प्रत्युद्यातास्त्वमर्षिताः ।
यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं यथासत्त्वं च संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: We too, roaring back, went out to meet them in anger, each according to strength, spirit and courage in the battle.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा च हार्दिक्यो युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत् ।
द्रोणं प्रति जिघांसन्तं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: Kritavarman, son of Hridika, rushed at Yudhishthira, who was making for Drona, as one mad elephant at another.

verses.text:
शैनेयं शरवर्षाणि विकिरन्तं समन्ततः ।
अभ्ययात्कौरवो राजन्भूरिः संग्राममूर्धनि ॥

meaning.en: Bhuri, the Kaurava, went at the head of the battle against Shaineya (Satyaki), who was scattering showers of arrows on every side.

verses.text:
सहदेवमथायान्तं द्रोणप्रेप्सुं महारथम् ।
कर्णो वैकर्तनो राजन्वारयामास पाण्डवम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, son of Vikarta, held back the Pandava Sahadeva, the great warrior who was coming to get Drona.

verses.text:
भीमसेनमथायान्तं व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम् ।
स्वयं दुर्योधनो युद्धे प्रतीपं मृत्युमाव्रजत् ॥

meaning.en: When Bhimasena came on like Death with gaping mouth, Duryodhana himself went to meet him in battle, as if going into the teeth of death.

verses.text:
नकुलं च युधां श्रेष्ठं सर्वयुद्धविशारदम् ।
शकुनिः सौबलो राजन्वारयामास सत्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni, Subala's son, quickly checked Nakula, best of fighters, skilled in every kind of war.

verses.text:
शिखण्डिनमथायान्तं रथेन रथिनां वरम् ।
कृपो शारद्वतो राजन्वारयामास संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Kripa, son of Sharadvat, checked Shikhandi in the battle, the best of charioteers, as he came on in his chariot.

verses.text:
प्रतिविन्ध्यमथायान्तं मयूरसदृशैर्हयैः ।
दुःशासनो महाराज यत्तो यत्तमवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Dushasana, alert, stopped the alert Pratívindhya as he came on with horses like peacocks, great king.

verses.text:
भैमसेनिमथायान्तं मायाशतविशारदम् ।
अश्वत्थामा पितुर्मानं कुर्वाणः प्रत्यषेधयत् ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthaman stopped the son of Bhima (Ghatotkacha), who was skilled in hundreds of illusions, honoring his father's standing.

verses.text:
द्रुपदं वृषसेनस्तु ससैन्यं सपदानुगम् ।
वारयामास समरे द्रोणप्रेप्सुं महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Vrishasena stopped Drupada with his army and followers, the great warrior who wished to reach Drona.

verses.text:
विराटं द्रुतमायान्तं द्रोणस्य निधनं प्रति ।
मद्रराजः सुसंक्रुद्धो वारयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: The king of the Madras, very angry, held back Virata, who was rushing at Drona to kill him, O Bharata.

verses.text:
शतानीकमथायान्तं नाकुलिं रभसं रणे ।
चित्रसेनो रुरोधाशु शरैर्द्रोणवधेप्सया ॥

meaning.en: Chitrasena quickly stopped Nakula's son Shatanika, who was eager in the fight, with arrows, wanting Drona to be killed.

verses.text:
अर्जुनं च युधां श्रेष्ठं प्राद्रवन्तं महारथम् ।
अलम्बुसो महाराज राक्षसेन्द्रो न्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Alambusa, the lord of rakshasas, stopped Arjuna, best of fighters and a great warrior, as he rushed forward.

verses.text:
तथा द्रोणं महेष्वासं निघ्नन्तं शात्रवान्रणे ।
धृष्टद्युम्नोऽथ पाञ्चाल्यो हृष्टरूपमवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: And Dhrishtadyumna, the Panchala, checked the mighty archer Drona, who was killing enemies in battle, in his joy.

verses.text:
तथान्यान्पाण्डुपुत्राणां समायातान्महारथान् ।
तावका रथिनो राजन्वारयामासुरोजसा ॥

meaning.en: And your charioteers, O king, held back with their strength the other great warriors of Pandu's sons who had come up.

verses.text:
गजारोहा गजैस्तूर्णं संनिपत्य महामृधे ।
योधयन्तः स्म दृश्यन्ते शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Elephant-riders, closing quickly in that great battle with their elephants, were seen fighting by hundreds and thousands.

verses.text:
निशीथे तुरगा राजन्नाद्रवन्तः परस्परम् ।
समदृश्यन्त वेगेन पक्षवन्त इवाद्रयः ॥

meaning.en: At midnight, O king, horses running at one another were seen rushing, like winged mountains.

verses.text:
सादिनः सादिभिः सार्धं प्रासशक्त्यृष्टिपाणयः ।
समागच्छन्महाराज विनदन्तः पृथक्पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: Horsemen, with spears, lances and darts in hand, met other horsemen, O great king, each roaring separately.

verses.text:
नरास्तु बहवस्तत्र समाजग्मुः परस्परम् ।
गदाभिर्मुसलैश्चैव नानाशस्त्रैश्च संघशः ॥

meaning.en: Many men came together there with maces, clubs and various weapons, in bands.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा तु हार्दिक्यो धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
वारयामास संक्रुद्धो वेलेवोद्वृत्तमर्णवम् ॥

meaning.en: Kritavarman, son of Hridika, in anger held back Yudhishthira, son of Dharma, as the shore holds back a swelling sea.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरस्तु हार्दिक्यं विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः ।
पुनर्विव्याध विंशत्या तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira pierced Hardikya with five swift arrows, and again with twenty, and said, "Stand, stand!"

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा तु संक्रुद्धो धर्मपुत्रस्य मारिष ।
धनुश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन तं च विव्याध सप्तभिः ॥

meaning.en: Kritavarman, enraged, cut Dharma's son's bow with a broad-headed arrow, and pierced him with seven.

verses.text:
अथान्यद्धनुरादाय धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
हार्दिक्यं दशभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Yudhishthira, Dharma's son, taking another bow, struck Hardikya with ten arrows in his arms and chest.

verses.text:
माधवस्तु रणे विद्धो धर्मपुत्रेण मारिष ।
प्राकम्पत च रोषेण सप्तभिश्चार्दयच्छरैः ॥

meaning.en: The Madhava (Kritavarman), struck in battle by Dharma's son, trembled with anger and wounded him with seven arrows.

verses.text:
तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा हस्तावापं निकृत्य च ।
प्राहिणोन्निशितान्बाणान्पञ्च राजञ्शिलाशितान् ॥

meaning.en: Cutting his bow and slicing off his hand guard, Partha sent five sharp, stone-whetted arrows at him, O king.

verses.text:
ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा हेमचित्रं महाधनम् ।
प्राविशन्धरणीमुग्रा वल्मीकमिव पन्नगाः ॥

meaning.en: They pierced his costly armor, bright with gold, and entered the earth fiercely, like snakes into an anthill.

verses.text:
अक्ष्णोर्निमेषमात्रेण सोऽन्यदादाय कार्मुकम् ।
विव्याध पाण्डवं षष्ट्या सूतं च नवभिः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: In the blink of an eye he took another bow and pierced the Pandava with sixty arrows and his charioteer with nine.

verses.text:
तस्य शक्तिममेयात्मा पाण्डवो भुजगोपमाम् ।
चिक्षेप भरतश्रेष्ठ रथे न्यस्य महद्धनुः ॥

meaning.en: The immeasurable Pandava, setting his great bow down in the chariot, hurled at him a spear like a snake, O best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
सा हेमचित्रा महती पाण्डवेन प्रवेरिता ।
निर्भिद्य दक्षिणं बाहुं प्राविशद्धरणीतलम् ॥

meaning.en: That great, gold-bright spear, sent by the Pandava, tore through Kritavarman's right arm and entered the ground.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु गृह्य पार्थः पुनर्धनुः ।
हार्दिक्यं छादयामास शरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: At that very time, taking up his bow again, Partha covered Hardikya with bent-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
ततस्तु समरे शूरो वृष्णीनां प्रवरो रथी ।
व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे निमेषार्धाद्युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the brave chariot-warrior, foremost of the Vrishnis, in half a moment left Yudhishthira without horses, charioteer or chariot.

verses.text:
ततस्तु पाण्डवो ज्येष्ठः खड्गचर्म समाददे ।
तदस्य निशितैर्बाणैर्व्यधमन्माधवो रणे ॥

meaning.en: Then the eldest Pandava took up sword and shield; but the Madhava shattered them in the battle with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
तोमरं तु ततो गृह्य स्वर्णदण्डं दुरासदम् ।
प्रेषयत्समरे तूर्णं हार्दिक्यस्य युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Then Yudhishthira took a hard-to-meet javelin with a gold shaft and quickly hurled it at Hardikya in the fight.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं सहसा धर्मराजभुजच्युतम् ।
द्विधा चिच्छेद हार्दिक्यः कृतहस्तः स्मयन्निव ॥

meaning.en: As it came suddenly, loosed from the arm of the king of dharma, Hardikya, skilled in hand, cut it in two, as if smiling.

verses.text:
ततः शरशतेनाजौ धर्मपुत्रमवाकिरत् ।
कवचं चास्य संक्रुद्धः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरदारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then he showered Dharma's son with a hundred arrows in the battle, and in anger split his armor with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
हार्दिक्यशरसंछिन्नं कवचं तन्महात्मनः ।
व्यशीर्यत रणे राजंस्ताराजालमिवाम्बरात् ॥

meaning.en: That great-souled man's armor, cut by Hardikya's arrows, fell apart in the battle, O king, like a net of stars falling from the sky.

verses.text:
स छिन्नधन्वा विरथः शीर्णवर्मा शरार्दितः ।
अपायासीद्रणात्तूर्णं धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: With his bow cut, chariotless, his armor shattered and tormented by arrows, Yudhishthira, son of Dharma, quickly left the battle.

verses.text:
कृतवर्मा तु निर्जित्य धर्मपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
पुनर्द्रोणस्य जुगुपे चक्रमेव महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Having beaten Yudhishthira, Kritavarman, the very strong, again guarded Drona's wheel.
